segments.title: 第82章 錄歌
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 82: Recording a Song

"So you still live on campus?"

Chatting in the recording studio, Xu Youyu was a little surprised, "Don't you live here alone? Even though it's a bit far from school, it's still more comfortable than a dorm room, right?"

"I've never lived on campus before, so I was curious." Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and thought for a moment, "But..."

"But you still feel it's more comfortable to be at home alone, right?" Xu Youyu finished her sentence with a grin.

"Mhm... It's just that I feel like the others don't really like me." Yan Zhusheng frowned and said, "I might not be very good at getting along with people."

"Hm? Why don't they like you?" Xu Youyu found it a bit strange, "You don't seem like a person with a bad personality."

"Maybe I'm just disliked." Yan Zhusheng thought for a moment, "During the two days of military training at school, two girls in my dorm told me they got their periods and asked if they could take a leave of absence to rest."

"Mhm." Xu Youyu nodded, "And then? You didn't say yes, did you?"

"I didn't." Yan Zhusheng said, "Li Luo said that the reason the class has a female PE representative is that he was worried some girls would be too shy to speak up, so..."

"So what?"

"So I told them to come into the bathroom with me, and I would help them check. If they really had their periods, I would approve their leave, but they weren't even using sanitary pads."

Xu Youyu was speechless.

"I think I understand where the problem is now." Xu Youyu shook her head with a wry smile, "Although it's a matter of emotional intelligence, it's not really your fault. But that's just those two, what about the others in the dorm?"

"Those two are more outgoing." Yan Zhusheng recalled, "I don't know what happened, but after that, the other girls didn't really talk to me much either."

"I see." Xu Youyu narrowed her eyes, then smiled, "This reminds me of my time in middle school."

"Middle school?"

"Yeah." Xu Youyu said with a smile, "I also lived on campus in middle school. There was a boy in my class who liked me and would always pester me, but I usually ignored him."

"But one of the girls in my dorm really liked that boy, to the point of obsession."

"Then one day, she actually came up to me and asked if I could accept the boy's pursuit for her sake. I was completely stunned."

"What happened then?" Yan Zhusheng asked curiously.

"Of course, I didn't agree. So she started badmouthing me behind my back everywhere and got the other roommates to isolate me along with her."

"I was still young back then, and at first, I was a bit angry and helpless. But my dad told me something, and I can share it with you." Xu Youyu grinned, looking at Yan Zhusheng.

Yan Zhusheng had already sat down at the piano. She looked at Xu Youyu, wondering what her father had said.

"My dad said that the more beautiful and outstanding a girl is, the more temptations she will face."

"It's a gift from heaven, but also a curse."

"When you accept the advantages that come with your appearance, whether actively or passively, you are bound to suffer losses in other aspects."

"My dad said he could go to the teachers for me, to the other party's parents, or even talk to Yucai's principal and make the other kid apologize."

"But things like this will keep happening as long as I remain just as beautiful and outstanding."

"When I was little, my father could still protect me like that, but he hoped I could learn to face these things head-on."

Yan Zhusheng nodded with partial understanding, her fingers lightly tapping on the piano keys, a soothing rhythm flowing out slowly.

"So where are you living now, senior?"

"Now? I'm living at Li Luo's place." Xu Youyu said with a smile, "Originally, I was renting, but I didn't expect his family to buy the apartment. Then Li Luo and Ying Chanxi moved there too, right next to the First Affiliated High School."

"So the three of you are living together now?" Yan Zhusheng suddenly showed a slightly envious expression.

"Yup."

"Speaking of which," Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and thought for a while, "Li Luo doesn't seem to have that many issues, although he does sneak glances at my face sometimes."

"Haha, he even steals glances at my chest." Xu Youyu took advantage of Li Luo's absence to expose him, "Boys are all the same. They think they're being discreet, but that kind of look is really easy to catch."

"But Li Luo is a nice person."

"That's true." Xu Youyu nodded, "He's quite interesting to be around. I don't even get that mad when he sneaks a look at me."

"Who's sneaking a look at you?"

From outside the door, Li Luo pushed it open and walked in, asking with a curious look, "What are you talking about?"

When Li Luo entered, Yan Zhusheng deliberately observed his gaze, then turned her head to look at Xu Youyu's chest and revealed a look of sudden realization, "You really do look at the senior's chest?"

"Hey!" Before Li Luo could say anything, Xu Youyu was the one who got flustered, "Don't say things like that to his face!"

"Wait... what on earth are you guys talking about?" Li Luo's face was covered in dark lines.

"Where's Xixi?" Xu Youyu coughed twice, abruptly changing the subject, "Why didn't she come up?"

"She's in the bathroom, so I came up first." Li Luo glanced at her, then walked over to Yan Zhusheng's side, temporarily putting the previous topic out of his mind, "So how do we record the song?"

"Just use that microphone." Yan Zhusheng pointed to the mic next to them, "Put on the headphones, then follow the music inside and sing the song. After the vocals are recorded, they can be directly added to the arranged music."

"So they really aren't recorded at the same time." Xu Youyu blinked, leaning closer to look at the microphone and headphones, "In that case, does that mean we'll only be able to hear Li Luo's a cappella singing?"

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded, "Only he will have the music in his headphones. We will only hear his singing. This way, any flaws in the vocals will be very obvious, and it'll be easier for me to correct his problems."

"Uh... if I don't sing well, don't laugh at me."

"Don't worry, don't worry." Xu Youyu sat down on a stool and said with a chuckle, "You'll be wearing headphones, so you won't hear us laughing anyway."

"...You're really good at comforting people."

Li Luo made some preparations in the recording studio, and Yan Zhusheng personally explained the functions of the microphone and headphones to him.

After Ying Chanxi finished using the bathroom and came up to the second floor, the recording session officially began.

"Maybe I shouldn't be in your world"

"When you receive the love letter"

"It also means I have already gone far away"

By five in the evening, Li Luo had already lost count of how many times he had sung.

After this take was finished, Ying Chanxi handed him a cup of water. Li Luo took it, drank some to moisten his throat, and sighed, "How was it this time?"

"Let's just use the fifth version." Yan Zhusheng said honestly, "I feel that one had the best result."

"But I've sung it at least a dozen times." Li Luo looked at Yan Zhusheng with weary eyes, inexplicably reminded of all the bizarre clients he had encountered in his past life.

"Recording a song is like this." Yan Zhusheng said, "The singer just needs to immerse themselves in the music, but the recording engineer has a tiring job. They have to pick the best version from many takes with subtle differences."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo rolled his eyes and stretched in the recording studio, "Let's call it a day then. I'm going downstairs to cook."

(End of Chapter)
